'''Docking Bay 9''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Nightlily" /> The [[Transport/Legends|transport]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|229|Tellivar Lady}}</ref> ''[[Tellivar Lady]]'' under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fane]] landed in the docking bay<ref name="Nightlily" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]] [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]] met [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]], a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Tax collector/Legends|tax collector]] while looking for a way off of Tatooine. Trevagg told the H'nemthe about ''Tellivar Lady'' and promised to talk to Captain Fane about having Onith travel aboard the transport. However Trevagg&mdash;who was hoping to keep Onith on Tatooine for the night so he could ask her on a date&mdash;took his time getting to Docking Bay 9 and by the time he arrived the ship had departed.<ref name="Nightlily" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Tellivar Lady'' was first mentioned in the short story "[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale]]" written by [[Barbara Hambly]] and published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in the [[1995]] anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''.
